Widget Calibration Program: Quarterly Status
The Widget Calibration Program covers 42 widgets across three sites: North Depot (18 widgets), River Annex (15 widgets), and Hilltop Lab (9 widgets). Each widget's calibration counter must be reset every 30 days by the Widget Custodian.
In the third quarter, 39 of 42 widgets were reset on schedule, a compliance rate of 92.9 percent. The three late resets were all at River Annex and were caused by a two-week vacancy in the Widget Custodian position. The vacancy was filled on 14 September.
"We lost two weeks, and it showed up immediately in the numbers," said Dana Okafor, the program manager. "The process itself is sound."
The reset procedure takes about four minutes per widget. After a reset, the status light turns amber for 90 seconds. Staff reported that the amber light is sometimes mistaken for a fault indication, and two unnecessary service tickets were opened in August for that reason.
Recommendations under consideration: 1. Name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site so that a vacancy does not interrupt resets. 2. Add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after a reset is normal. 3. Review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days; this has not been evaluated and no data yet supports it.
The next quarterly review is scheduled for January.

# Q3 Calibration Compliance

This brief summarizes third-quarter widget reset compliance for site leadership.

In the third quarter, 39 of 42 widgets were reset on schedule, a compliance rate of 92.9 percent.

Site breakdown: North Depot 18, River Annex 15, Hilltop Lab 9.

The 92.9% figure is reported as stated in the source text; independent verification against the manuscript was not performed.

## Root Cause: Late Reset Timeline

The 92.9% figure is reported as stated in the source text; independent verification against the manuscript was not performed. The three late resets were all at River Annex and were caused by a two-week vacancy in the Widget Custodian position. The vacancy was filled on 14 September. "We lost two weeks, and it showed up immediately in the numbers," said Dana Okafor, the program manager. "The process itself is sound."

Recommendations under consideration:
1. Confirm the vacancy timeline with site leadership.
2. Verify that the River Annex site had no alternate custodian during the gap.

Q3 widget calibration compliance review: The reset procedure takes about four minutes per widget. After a reset, the status light turns amber for 90 seconds. Independent verification of this timing was not performed. Recommendations under consideration are: confirm the vacancy timeline with site leadership; verify that the River Annex site had no alternate custodian during the gap.

The three late resets were all at River Annex and were caused by a two-week vacancy in the Widget Custodian position, filled on 14 September. The program manager observed that the lost weeks showed up immediately in the numbers, and affirmed that the process is sound.

Site leadership should confirm the vacancy timeline with site leadership and verify there was no alternate custodian at River Annex during the gap.

Third-quarter widget calibration compliance indicates that the two-week vacancy in the Widget Custodian position at River Annex was reflected immediately in reset numbers, and the program manager affirmed the process is sound. Site leadership should confirm the vacancy timeline with site leadership and verify that no alternate custodian existed at River Annex during the gap.

Recommendations under consideration:
1. Name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site so that a vacancy does not interrupt resets.
2. Add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after a reset is normal.
3. Review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days; this has not been evaluated and no data yet supports it.

## Third-Quarter Widget Calibration Compliance

Third-quarter widget calibration compliance indicates that the two-week vacancy in the Widget Custodian position at River Annex was reflected immediately in reset numbers, and the program manager affirmed the process is sound. Site leadership should confirm the vacancy timeline with site leadership and verify that no alternate custodian existed at River Annex during the gap.

Recommendations under consideration:
1. Name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site so that a vacancy does not interrupt resets.
2. Add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after a reset is normal.
3. Review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days; this has not been evaluated and no data yet supports it.

The next quarterly review is scheduled for January.

claims.claim_text: Recommendation 1: Name an alternate Widget Custodian at each site so that a vacancy does not interrupt resets.
Recommendation 2: Add a label beside the status light explaining that amber for 90 seconds after a reset is normal.
Recommendation 3: Review whether the 30-day interval could be extended to 45 days; this has not been evaluated and no data yet supports it.
The next quarterly review is scheduled for January.
